stem.text: Which diagram shows a couple formed by two forces, each of magnitude $F$, acting on a rod?

A.alt: Diagram of a horizontal rod with two downward arrows labelled F, one at each end.

B.alt: Diagram of a horizontal rod with a downward arrow labelled F at its left end and an arrow labelled F at its right end pointing up and to the right.

C.alt: Diagram of a horizontal rod with a downward arrow labelled F at its left end and a horizontal arrow labelled F pointing right from its right end.

D.alt: Diagram of a horizontal rod with an upward arrow labelled F at its left end and a downward arrow labelled F at its right end.
